name: fantasy-wallpaper-studio
description: Native subagent workflows for painterly fantasy wallpapers and commercially oriented Adobe Stock artwork with evidence-based review.

interface.longDescription: Create matching vivo/iPad fantasy wallpapers, original Adobe Stock illustrations, or separately composed editions of both. Native subagents provide concepts, art direction, actual-image review, and Stock compliance and English metadata. Stock readiness requires measured files and verified rights. Requires host subagent and image tools.
